# =============================================================================
# IP Address Registry
# =============================================================================
# Central registry of all static IP allocations in the homelab.
# This file serves as the single source of truth for IP assignments.
#
# Network Architecture:
#   - 192.168.1.0/24 (vmbr0): Home LAN - FIOS router, external access
#   - 10.100.0.0/16  (vmbr1): Container network - internal services
#
# IP Scheme (Container ID aligned with IP):
#   - 10.100.1.x:  Core services (LXC 100-149)
#   - 10.100.2.x:  Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249)
#   - 10.100.3.x:  Media - Photos (LXC 300-349)
#   - 10.100.4.x:  Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449)
#   - 10.100.5.x:  Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549)
#
# Dual-NIC Services (need 192.168.1.x for LAN compatibility):
#   - Traefik: Reverse proxy for LAN clients
#   - AdGuard: DNS for LAN devices
#   - Jellyfin: DLNA/casting
#   - Immich: Mobile app sync
# =============================================================================

locals {
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Network Configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  network = {
    # Home LAN (vmbr0)
    lan_gateway = "192.168.1.1"
    lan_netmask = "/24"
    lan_prefix  = "192.168.1"

    # Container network (vmbr1)
    container_gateway = "10.100.0.1"
    container_netmask = "/16"
    container_prefix  = "10.100"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IP Registry - Container Network (10.100.x.x)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pattern: 10.100.<category>.<container_id_suffix>
  # Example: LXC 304 -> 10.100.3.104 (category 3, suffix 04)

  ip_registry = {
    # Infrastructure (192.168.1.x only - not containers)
    infrastructure = {
      router  = "192.168.1.1"    # Verizon FIOS router
      proxmox = "192.168.1.215"  # Proxmox VE host (vmbr0)
      # Proxmox also has 10.100.0.1 on vmbr1 (gateway for containers)
    }

    # Core services (LXC 100-149) -> 10.100.1.x
    core = {
      portainer        = "10.100.1.100"  # LXC 100 - Container management
      network_services = "10.100.1.101"  # LXC 101 - AdGuard DNS + Tailscale
      pbs              = "10.100.1.102"  # LXC 102 - Proxmox Backup Server
    }

    # Dashboards & Auth (LXC 200-249) -> 10.100.2.x
    dashboards = {
      traefik    = "10.100.2.200"  # LXC 200 - Reverse proxy
      dashboards = "10.100.2.201"  # LXC 201 - Homepage + Dashy
      authelia   = "10.100.2.202"  # LXC 202 - SSO/Auth
    }

    # Media - Photos (LXC 300-349) -> 10.100.3.x
    photos = {
      immich_importer = "10.100.3.103"  # LXC 303 - Photo import
      immich          = "10.100.3.104"  # LXC 304 - Photo management
    }

    # Media - Streaming (LXC 400-449) -> 10.100.4.x
    media = {
      jellyfin         = "10.100.4.101"  # LXC 401 - Media server + Jellystat
      media_management = "10.100.4.102"  # LXC 402 - Arr stack
    }

    # Monitoring & AI (LXC 500-549) -> 10.100.5.x
    monitoring = {
      monitoring    = "10.100.5.100"  # LXC 500 - Prometheus, Grafana, etc
      openwebui     = "10.100.5.101"  # LXC 501 - AI chat
      n8n           = "10.100.5.102"  # LXC 502 - Workflow automation
      obsidian_sync = "10.100.5.103"  # LXC 503 - Obsidian LiveSync (CouchDB)
    }
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # LAN IPs for Dual-NIC Services (192.168.1.x)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # These services need direct LAN access for compatibility with home devices

  lan_ips = {
    traefik          = "192.168.1.235"  # LXC 200 - LAN clients access services
    network_services = "192.168.1.196"  # LXC 101 - DNS for LAN devices
    jellyfin         = "192.168.1.226"  # LXC 401 - DLNA/casting
    immich           = "192.168.1.222"  # LXC 304 - Mobile app sync
    immich_importer  = "192.168.1.159"  # LXC 303 - Photo import (existing)
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Container ID to IP Mapping
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  container_ips = {
    # Core (100-149)
    100 = local.ip_registry.core.portainer
    101 = local.ip_registry.core.network_services
    102 = local.ip_registry.core.pbs

    # Dashboards & Auth (200-249)
    200 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.traefik
    201 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.dashboards
    202 = local.ip_registry.dashboards.authelia

    # Photos (300-349)
    303 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich_importer
    304 = local.ip_registry.photos.immich

    # Media (400-449)
    401 = local.ip_registry.media.jellyfin
    402 = local.ip_registry.media.media_management

    # Monitoring & AI (500-549)
    500 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.monitoring
    501 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.openwebui
    502 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.n8n
    503 = local.ip_registry.monitoring.obsidian_sync
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Helper: Get IP with CIDR notation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ip_cidr = {
    for name, ip in merge(
      local.ip_registry.core,
      local.ip_registry.dashboards,
      local.ip_registry.photos,
      local.ip_registry.media,
      local.ip_registry.monitoring,
    ) : name => "${ip}${local.network.container_netmask}"
  }

  lan_ip_cidr = {
    for name, ip in local.lan_ips : name => "${ip}${local.network.lan_netmask}"
  }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Convenience: Traefik IP for route modules
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Used by traefik-route modules to sync config to Traefik LXC via SSH
  # Must use LAN IP since container network isn't routable from local machine
  traefik_ip = local.lan_ips.traefik

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Flatten all allocated IPs for validation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  _all_container_ips = concat(
    values(local.ip_registry.core),
    values(local.ip_registry.dashboards),
    values(local.ip_registry.photos),
    values(local.ip_registry.media),
    values(local.ip_registry.monitoring),
  )

  _all_lan_ips = values(local.lan_ips)
}

# Homelab Infrastructure Automation
# https://taskfile.dev

version: '3'

vars:
  PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.TASKFILE_DIR}}"
  TOFU_DIR: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu"

env:
  # State encryption passphrase - MUST be TF_VAR because encryption runs before providers
  # All other secrets are now fetched via 1Password provider directly in OpenTofu
  TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase:
    sh: |
      if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
        echo "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
      else
        op read "op://homelab/opentofu/password" 2>/dev/null || echo ""
      fi

# =============================================================================
# Included Taskfiles (flattened into main namespace)
# =============================================================================
includes:
  tofu:
    taskfile: ./tasks/tofu.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  backup:
    taskfile: ./tasks/backup.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  cloud:
    taskfile: ./tasks/cloud.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  template:
    taskfile: ./tasks/template.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  pbs:
    taskfile: ./tasks/pbs.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"

tasks:
  # ===========================================================================
  # Desktop LXC (Temporary GUI for Downloads)
  # ===========================================================================

  desktop:create:
    desc: "Create temporary GUI desktop LXC for downloading Google Takeout"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/create.sh

  desktop:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy temporary GUI desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/destroy.sh

  desktop:info:
    desc: "Show VNC connection info for desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        IP=$(ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- ip -4 addr show eth0 | grep inet | awk '{print \$2}' | cut -d/ -f1" 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
          echo "Desktop LXC (600) is not running or does not exist."
          echo "Run 'task desktop:create' first."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "=== Desktop LXC VNC Connection ==="
        echo ""
        echo "VNC Host: $IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "macOS: Open Finder, Cmd+K, enter vnc://$IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "Downloads save to: /downloads (mounted to /tank/photo-import)"

  desktop:restart-vnc:
    desc: "Restart VNC server on desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Restarting VNC server..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- bash -c 'vncserver -kill :1 2>/dev/null || true; vncserver :1 -geometry 1920x1080 -depth 24 -localhost no'"
        echo "VNC server restarted on display :1"

  # ===========================================================================
  # Authelia Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  authelia:secrets:
    desc: "Generate Authelia secrets from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        SECRETS_DIR="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/secrets"
        mkdir -p "$SECRETS_DIR"
        echo "Fetching secrets from 1Password..."
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/jwt_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/jwt_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/session_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/session_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/storage_encryption_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/storage_encryption_key"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_hmac_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_hmac_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_private_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_private_key"
        chmod 600 "$SECRETS_DIR"/*
        echo "Secrets written to $SECRETS_DIR"

  authelia:users:
    desc: "Generate Authelia users database from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        USERS_FILE="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/authelia/users_database.yml"
        HASH=$(op read "op://homelab/authelia/admin_password_hash")
        if [ "$HASH" = "PLACEHOLDER_RUN_DOCKER_TO_GENERATE" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: admin_password_hash is still a placeholder."
          echo "Run: docker run --rm -it authelia/authelia:latest authelia crypto hash generate argon2"
          echo "Then update 1Password: op item edit authelia --vault=homelab 'admin_password_hash=YOUR_HASH'"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "users:" > "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "  admin:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    displayname: \"Admin\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    email: admin@homelab.rambtech.dev" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    password: \"$HASH\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    groups:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - admins" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - users" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "Users database written to $USERS_FILE"

  authelia:setup:
    desc: "Full Authelia setup (secrets + users)"
    cmds:
      - task: authelia:secrets
      - task: authelia:users
      - echo "Authelia setup complete. Run 'task tofu:apply APP=authelia' to deploy."

  # ===========================================================================
  # AdGuard DNS Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  adguard:test:
    desc: "Test DNS resolution for homelab domains"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh test

  # ===========================================================================
  # Immich Importer Setup
  # ===========================================================================

  immich-importer:secrets:
    desc: "Generate immich-importer terraform.tfvars from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        TFVARS="{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/immich-importer/terraform.tfvars"
        echo "Fetching secrets from 1Password..."

        B2_KEY_ID=$(op read "op://homelab/Backblaze/keyId")
        B2_APP_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/Backblaze/b2_app_key")
        CRYPT_PASS=$(op read "op://homelab/backblaze-rclone-crypt/password_obscured")
        CRYPT_SALT=$(op read "op://homelab/backblaze-rclone-crypt/password2_obscured")
        IMMICH_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/ecdglhzani6r76zniumdzrjdoy/immich-go")

        cat > "$TFVARS" << EOF
        # Auto-generated from 1Password - DO NOT COMMIT
        b2_account_id          = "$B2_KEY_ID"
        b2_application_key     = "$B2_APP_KEY"
        rclone_crypt_password  = "$CRYPT_PASS"
        rclone_crypt_password2 = "$CRYPT_SALT"
        immich_api_key         = "$IMMICH_KEY"
        cloud_backup_schedule  = "0 3 * * 0,3"
        EOF

        echo "terraform.tfvars written to $TFVARS"

  immich-importer:cron:status:
    desc: "Show cron job status on immich-importer LXC"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- crontab -l"

  # ===========================================================================
  # IP Address Management
  # ===========================================================================

  ip:next:
    desc: "Show the next available IP address for new LXC deployment"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/ip/next.sh

  ip:list:
    desc: "Show all allocated IP addresses"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/ip/list.sh

  # ===========================================================================
  # Cleanup & Maintenance
  # ===========================================================================

  cleanup:
    desc: "Clean up temporary files, backups, and cruft (dry run)"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/cleanup.sh

  cleanup:run:
    desc: "Clean up temporary files, backups, and cruft (actually delete)"
    cmds:

# Homelab Infrastructure Automation
# https://taskfile.dev

version: '3'

vars:
  PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.TASKFILE_DIR}}"
  TOFU_DIR: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu"

env:
  # State encryption passphrase - MUST be TF_VAR because encryption runs before providers
  # All other secrets are now fetched via 1Password provider directly in OpenTofu
  TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase:
    sh: |
      if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
        echo "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
      else
        op read "op://homelab/opentofu/password" 2>/dev/null || echo ""
      fi

# =============================================================================
# Included Taskfiles (flattened into main namespace)
# =============================================================================
includes:
  tofu:
    taskfile: ./tasks/tofu.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  backup:
    taskfile: ./tasks/backup.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  cloud:
    taskfile: ./tasks/cloud.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  template:
    taskfile: ./tasks/template.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  pbs:
    taskfile: ./tasks/pbs.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"

tasks:
  # ===========================================================================
  # Desktop LXC (Temporary GUI for Downloads)
  # ===========================================================================

  desktop:create:
    desc: "Create temporary GUI desktop LXC for downloading Google Takeout"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/create.sh

  desktop:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy temporary GUI desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/destroy.sh

  desktop:info:
    desc: "Show VNC connection info for desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        IP=$(ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- ip -4 addr show eth0 | grep inet | awk '{print \$2}' | cut -d/ -f1" 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
          echo "Desktop LXC (600) is not running or does not exist."
          echo "Run 'task desktop:create' first."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "=== Desktop LXC VNC Connection ==="
        echo ""
        echo "VNC Host: $IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "macOS: Open Finder, Cmd+K, enter vnc://$IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "Downloads save to: /downloads (mounted to /tank/photo-import)"

  desktop:restart-vnc:
    desc: "Restart VNC server on desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Restarting VNC server..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- bash -c 'vncserver -kill :1 2>/dev/null || true; vncserver :1 -geometry 1920x1080 -depth 24 -localhost no'"
        echo "VNC server restarted on display :1"

  # ===========================================================================
  # Authelia Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  authelia:secrets:
    desc: "Generate Authelia secrets from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        SECRETS_DIR="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/secrets"
        mkdir -p "$SECRETS_DIR"
        echo "Fetching secrets from 1Password..."
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/jwt_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/jwt_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/session_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/session_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/storage_encryption_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/storage_encryption_key"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_hmac_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_hmac_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_private_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_private_key"
        chmod 600 "$SECRETS_DIR"/*
        echo "Secrets written to $SECRETS_DIR"

  authelia:users:
    desc: "Generate Authelia users database from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        USERS_FILE="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/authelia/users_database.yml"
        HASH=$(op read "op://homelab/authelia/admin_password_hash")
        if [ "$HASH" = "PLACEHOLDER_RUN_DOCKER_TO_GENERATE" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: admin_password_hash is still a placeholder."
          echo "Run: docker run --rm -it authelia/authelia:latest authelia crypto hash generate argon2"
          echo "Then update 1Password: op item edit authelia --vault=homelab 'admin_password_hash=YOUR_HASH'"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "users:" > "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "  admin:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    displayname: \"Admin\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    email: admin@homelab.rambtech.dev" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    password: \"$HASH\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    groups:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - admins" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - users" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "Users database written to $USERS_FILE"

  authelia:setup:
    desc: "Full Authelia setup (secrets + users)"
    cmds:
      - task: authelia:secrets
      - task: authelia:users
      - echo "Authelia setup complete. Run 'task tofu:apply APP=authelia' to deploy."

  # ===========================================================================
  # AdGuard DNS Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  adguard:test:
    desc: "Test DNS resolution for homelab domains"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh test

  # ===========================================================================
  # Immich Importer Setup
  # ===========================================================================

  immich-importer:secrets:
    desc: "Generate immich-importer terraform.tfvars from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        TFVARS="{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/immich-importer/terraform.tfvars"
        echo "Fetching secrets from 1Password..."

        B2_KEY_ID=$(op read "op://homelab/Backblaze/keyId")
        B2_APP_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/Backblaze/b2_app_key")
        CRYPT_PASS=$(op read "op://homelab/backblaze-rclone-crypt/password_obscured")
        CRYPT_SALT=$(op read "op://homelab/backblaze-rclone-crypt/password2_obscured")
        IMMICH_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/ecdglhzani6r76zniumdzrjdoy/immich-go")

        cat > "$TFVARS" << EOF
        # Auto-generated from 1Password - DO NOT COMMIT
        b2_account_id          = "$B2_KEY_ID"
        b2_application_key     = "$B2_APP_KEY"
        rclone_crypt_password  = "$CRYPT_PASS"
        rclone_crypt_password2 = "$CRYPT_SALT"
        immich_api_key         = "$IMMICH_KEY"
        cloud_backup_schedule  = "0 3 * * 0,3"
        EOF

        echo "terraform.tfvars written to $TFVARS"

  immich-importer:cron:status:
    desc: "Show cron job status on immich-importer LXC"
    cmds:
      - ssh root@homelab "pct exec 303 -- crontab -l"

  # ===========================================================================
  # IP Address Management
  # ===========================================================================

  ip:next:
    desc: "Show the next available IP address for new LXC deployment"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/ip/next.sh

  ip:list:
    desc: "Show all allocated IP addresses"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/ip/list.sh

  # ===========================================================================
  # Cleanup & Maintenance
  # ===========================================================================

  cleanup:
    desc: "Clean up temporary files, backups, and cruft (dry run)"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/cleanup.sh

  cleanup:run:
    desc: "Clean up temporary files, backups, and cruft (actually delete)"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/cleanup.sh --run

  # ===========================================================================
  # Local Development
  # ===========================================================================

  dev:dashboards:up:
    desc: "Start Homepage and Dashy locally for testing configs"
    dir: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/dev/dashboards"
    cmds:
      - docker compose up -d
      - |
        echo ""
        echo "=== Dashboard Dev Environment ==="
        echo ""
        echo "Homepage: http://localhost:3000"
        echo "Dashy:    http://localhost:4001"
        echo ""
        echo "Config files are mounted from tofu/apps/dashboards/deploy/"
        echo "Edit configs and refresh browser to see changes."
        echo "(Dashy may need container restart for config changes)"
        echo ""
        echo "Stop with: task dev:dashboards:down"

  dev:dashboards:down:
    desc: "Stop local dashboard dev environment"
    dir: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/dev/dashboards"
    cmds:
      - docker compose down

  dev:dashboards:logs:
    desc: "View logs from local dashboard containers"
    dir: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/dev/dashboards"
    cmds:
      - docker compose logs -f {{.SERVICE}}
    vars:
      SERVICE: '{{.SERVICE | default ""}}'

  dev:dashboards:restart:
    desc: "Restart local dashboard containers (useful after config changes)"
    dir: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/dev/dashboards"
    cmds:
      - docker compose restart {{.SERVICE}}
      - echo "Restarted. Dashy takes ~40s to fully start."
    vars:
      SERVICE: '{{.SERVICE | default ""}}'

Here's a summary of the new task commands:

## New Taskfile Commands

**iCloud Sync:**
| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `task icloud:auth` | Authenticate with Apple ID (interactive, requires 2FA) |
| `task icloud:status` | Check authentication and sync status |
| `task icloud:download` | Download photos from iCloud |
| `task icloud:import` | Import downloaded photos to Immich |
| `task icloud:sync` | Full sync (download + import) |

# Homelab Infrastructure Automation
# https://taskfile.dev

version: '3'

vars:
  PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.TASKFILE_DIR}}"
  TOFU_DIR: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu"

env:
  # State encryption passphrase - MUST be TF_VAR because encryption runs before providers
  # All other secrets are now fetched via 1Password provider directly in OpenTofu
  TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase:
    sh: |
      if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
        echo "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
      else
        op read "op://homelab/opentofu/password" 2>/dev/null || echo ""
      fi

# =============================================================================
# Included Taskfiles (flattened into main namespace)
# =============================================================================
includes:
  tofu:
    taskfile: ./tasks/tofu.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  backup:
    taskfile: ./tasks/backup.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  cloud:
    taskfile: ./tasks/cloud.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  template:
    taskfile: ./tasks/template.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  pbs:
    taskfile: ./tasks/pbs.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"

tasks:
  # ===========================================================================
  # Desktop LXC (Temporary GUI for Downloads)
  # ===========================================================================

  desktop:create:
    desc: "Create temporary GUI desktop LXC for downloading Google Takeout"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/create.sh

  desktop:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy temporary GUI desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/destroy.sh

  desktop:info:
    desc: "Show VNC connection info for desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        IP=$(ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- ip -4 addr show eth0 | grep inet | awk '{print \$2}' | cut -d/ -f1" 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
          echo "Desktop LXC (600) is not running or does not exist."
          echo "Run 'task desktop:create' first."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "=== Desktop LXC VNC Connection ==="
        echo ""
        echo "VNC Host: $IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "macOS: Open Finder, Cmd+K, enter vnc://$IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "Downloads save to: /downloads (mounted to /tank/photo-import)"

  desktop:restart-vnc:
    desc: "Restart VNC server on desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Restarting VNC server..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- bash -c 'vncserver -kill :1 2>/dev/null || true; vncserver :1 -geometry 1920x1080 -depth 24 -localhost no'"
        echo "VNC server restarted on display :1"

  # ===========================================================================
  # Authelia Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  authelia:secrets:
    desc: "Generate Authelia secrets from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        SECRETS_DIR="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/secrets"
        mkdir -p "$SECRETS_DIR"
        echo "Fetching secrets from 1Password..."
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/jwt_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/jwt_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/session_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/session_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/storage_encryption_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/storage_encryption_key"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_hmac_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_hmac_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_private_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_private_key"
        chmod 600 "$SECRETS_DIR"/*
        echo "Secrets written to $SECRETS_DIR"

  authelia:users:
    desc: "Generate Authelia users database from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        USERS_FILE="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/authelia/users_database.yml"
        HASH=$(op read "op://homelab/authelia/admin_password_hash")
        if [ "$HASH" = "PLACEHOLDER_RUN_DOCKER_TO_GENERATE" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: admin_password_hash is still a placeholder."
          echo "Run: docker run --rm -it authelia/authelia:latest authelia crypto hash generate argon2"
          echo "Then update 1Password: op item edit authelia --vault=homelab 'admin_password_hash=YOUR_HASH'"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "users:" > "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "  admin:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    displayname: \"Admin\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    email: admin@homelab.rambtech.dev" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    password: \"$HASH\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    groups:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - admins" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - users" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "Users database written to $USERS_FILE"

  authelia:setup:
    desc: "Full Authelia setup (secrets + users)"
    cmds:
      - task: authelia:secrets
      - task: authelia:users
      - echo "Authelia setup complete. Run 'task tofu:apply APP=authelia' to deploy."

  # ===========================================================================
  # AdGuard DNS Operations
  # ===========================================================================

  adguard:test:
    desc: "Test DNS resolution for homelab domains"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/sync/adguard-sync.sh test

        CRYPT_PASS=$(op read "op://homelab/backblaze-rclone-crypt/password_obscured")
        CRYPT_SALT=$(op read "op://homelab/backblaze-rclone-crypt/password2_obscured")
        IMMICH_KEY=$(op read "op://homelab/ecdglhzani6r76zniumdzrjdoy/immich-go")

        cat > "$TFVARS" << EOF
        # Auto-generated from 1Password - DO NOT COMMIT
        b2_account_id          = "$B2_KEY_ID"
        b2_application_key     = "$B2_APP_KEY"
        rclone_crypt_password  = "$CRYPT_PASS"
        rclone_crypt_password2 = "$CRYPT_SALT"

# Homelab Infrastructure Automation

  PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.TASKFILE_DIR}}"
  TOFU_DIR: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu"

env:
  # State encryption passphrase - MUST be TF_VAR because encryption runs before providers
  # All other secrets are now fetched via 1Password provider directly in OpenTofu
  TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase:
    sh: |
      if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
        echo "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
      else
        op read "op://homelab/opentofu/password" 2>/dev/null || echo ""
      fi

# Included Taskfiles (flattened into main namespace)

  tofu:
    taskfile: ./tasks/tofu.yml
    flatten: true

    taskfile: ./tasks/backup.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:

  cloud:
    taskfile: ./tasks/cloud.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:

    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  pbs:
    taskfile: ./tasks/pbs.yml
    flatten: true
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"
  importer:
    taskfile: ./tasks/immich-importer.yml
    vars:
      PROJECT_ROOT: "{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}"

tasks:
  # ===========================================================================
  # Desktop LXC (Temporary GUI for Downloads)
  # ===========================================================================

  desktop:create:
    desc: "Create temporary GUI desktop LXC for downloading Google Takeout"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/create.sh

  desktop:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy temporary GUI desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/desktop-lxc/destroy.sh

  desktop:info:
    desc: "Show VNC connection info for desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        IP=$(ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- ip -4 addr show eth0 | grep inet | awk '{print \$2}' | cut -d/ -f1" 2>/dev/null)
        if [ -z "$IP" ]; then
          echo "Desktop LXC (600) is not running or does not exist."
          echo "Run 'task desktop:create' first."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "=== Desktop LXC VNC Connection ==="
        echo ""
        echo "VNC Host: $IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "macOS: Open Finder, Cmd+K, enter vnc://$IP:5901"
        echo ""
        echo "Downloads save to: /downloads (mounted to /tank/photo-import)"

  desktop:restart-vnc:
    desc: "Restart VNC server on desktop LXC"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Restarting VNC server..."
        ssh root@homelab "pct exec 600 -- bash -c 'vncserver -kill :1 2>/dev/null || true; vncserver :1 -geometry 1920x1080 -depth 24 -localhost no'"
        echo "VNC server restarted on display :1"

  # ===========================================================================

  authelia:secrets:
    desc: "Generate Authelia secrets from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        SECRETS_DIR="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/secrets"
        mkdir -p "$SECRETS_DIR"
        echo "Fetching secrets from 1Password..."
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/jwt_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/jwt_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/session_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/session_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/storage_encryption_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/storage_encryption_key"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_hmac_secret" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_hmac_secret"
        op read "op://homelab/authelia/oidc_private_key" > "$SECRETS_DIR/oidc_private_key"
        chmod 600 "$SECRETS_DIR"/*
        echo "Secrets written to $SECRETS_DIR"

  authelia:users:
    desc: "Generate Authelia users database from 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        USERS_FILE="{{.PROJECT_ROOT}}/tofu/apps/authelia/deploy/authelia/users_database.yml"
        HASH=$(op read "op://homelab/authelia/admin_password_hash")
        if [ "$HASH" = "PLACEHOLDER_RUN_DOCKER_TO_GENERATE" ]; then
          echo "ERROR: admin_password_hash is still a placeholder."
          echo "Run: docker run --rm -it authelia/authelia:latest authelia crypto hash generate argon2"
          echo "Then update 1Password: op item edit authelia --vault=homelab 'admin_password_hash=YOUR_HASH'"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "users:" > "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "  admin:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    displayname: \"Admin\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    email: admin@homelab.rambtech.dev" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    password: \"$HASH\"" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "    groups:" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - admins" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "      - users" >> "$USERS_FILE"
        echo "Users database written to $USERS_FILE"

        immich_api_key         = "$IMMICH_KEY"
        cloud_backup_schedule  = "0 3 * * 0,3"

#!/bin/bash
# iCloud Photo Downloader + Immich Import
# Downloads photos from iCloud using icloudpd, then imports to Immich
#
# Usage:
#   icloud-sync.sh download     - Download new photos from iCloud
#   icloud-sync.sh import       - Import downloaded photos to Immich
#   icloud-sync.sh sync         - Download + Import (full sync)
#   icloud-sync.sh auth         - Authenticate with iCloud (2FA required)
#   icloud-sync.sh status       - Show sync status

set -eu

ACTION="${1:-sync}"
ICLOUD_DIR="${ICLOUD_DOWNLOAD_DIR:-/downloads/icloud}"
COOKIE_DIR="/root/.icloudpd"
LOG_FILE="/var/log/icloud-sync.log"
SUCCESS_FILE="/var/log/icloud-last-success"

# Immich settings
IMMICH_SERVER="${IMMICH_SERVER:-http://192.168.1.222:2283}"
IMMICH_API_KEY="${IMMICH_API_KEY:-}"

# ntfy settings
NTFY_SERVER="${NTFY_SERVER:-https://ntfy.homelab.rambtech.dev}"
NTFY_TOPIC="${NTFY_TOPIC:-icloud-sync}"

log() {
    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $*" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
}

# Send notification via ntfy
notify() {
    local title="$1"
    local message="$2"
    local priority="${3:-default}"
    local tags="${4:-cloud}"

    curl -s -o /dev/null \
        -H "Title: $title" \
        -H "Priority: $priority" \
        -H "Tags: $tags" \
        -d "$message" \
        "$NTFY_SERVER/$NTFY_TOPIC" || true
}

notify_error() {
    local message="$1"
    log "ERROR: $message"
    notify "iCloud Sync Failed" "$message" "high" "warning,icloud"
}

notify_success() {
    local message="$1"
    log "SUCCESS: $message"
    # Only notify success on first sync after a failure, or weekly
    # to avoid notification spam
}

check_auth() {
    if [ ! -d "$COOKIE_DIR" ] || [ -z "$(find "$COOKIE_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
        notify_error "Not authenticated with iCloud. Run: icloud-sync.sh auth"
        log "Run: icloud-sync.sh auth"
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

authenticate() {
    log "=== iCloud Authentication ==="
    log "This will prompt for 2FA code"
    echo ""

    mkdir -p "$COOKIE_DIR"

    # Interactive authentication
    icloudpd --username "$ICLOUD_USERNAME" \
        --directory "$ICLOUD_DIR" \
        --cookie-directory "$COOKIE_DIR" \
        --auth-only

    log "Authentication complete. Cookies saved to $COOKIE_DIR"
}

download_photos() {
    log "=== Downloading photos from iCloud ==="

    if ! check_auth; then
        return 1
    fi

    mkdir -p "$ICLOUD_DIR"

    log "Download directory: $ICLOUD_DIR"
    log "Starting icloudpd download..."

    # Download with sensible defaults:
    # - Skip videos (optional, remove --skip-videos to include)
    # - Keep original file dates
    # - Download live photos as both photo and video
    # - Use recent photos first (most likely to be new)
    # - Auto-delete from iCloud after download (disabled by default)
    icloudpd --username "$ICLOUD_USERNAME" \
        --directory "$ICLOUD_DIR" \
        --cookie-directory "$COOKIE_DIR" \
        --size original \
        --live-photo-size original \
        --align-raw jpeg \
        --set-exif-datetime \
        --no-progress-bar \
        --recent 500 \
        2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"

    local exit_code=${PIPESTATUS[0]}

    if [ "$exit_code" -eq 0 ]; then
        log "Download complete"
        date > "$SUCCESS_FILE"
    elif [ "$exit_code" -eq 1 ]; then
        notify_error "iCloud 2FA expired or auth error. SSH to immich-importer and run: icloud-sync.sh auth"
    else
        notify_error "iCloud download failed with exit code $exit_code. Check logs: /var/log/icloud-sync.log"
    fi

    return "$exit_code"
}

import_to_immich() {
    log "=== Importing to Immich ==="

    if [ -z "$IMMICH_API_KEY" ]; then
        log "ERROR: IMMICH_API_KEY not set"
        return 1
    fi

    if [ ! -d "$ICLOUD_DIR" ] || [ -z "$(find "$ICLOUD_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
        log "No photos to import in $ICLOUD_DIR"
        return 0
    fi

    log "Importing from: $ICLOUD_DIR"
    log "Immich server: $IMMICH_SERVER"

    # Use immich-go to upload
    # --skip-hash to speed up (Immich will dedupe anyway)
    immich-go -server "$IMMICH_SERVER" \
        -key "$IMMICH_API_KEY" \
        upload "$ICLOUD_DIR" \
        -create-albums \
        -album-name-template "iCloud/{year}/{month}" \
        2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"

    log "Import complete"
}

show_status() {
    echo "=== iCloud Sync Status ==="
    echo ""

    echo "Authentication:"
    if check_auth 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "  Status: Authenticated"
        echo "  Cookies: $COOKIE_DIR"
        ls -la "$COOKIE_DIR" 2>/dev/null | head -5
    else
        echo "  Status: NOT authenticated"
        echo "  Run: icloud-sync.sh auth"
    fi
    echo ""

    echo "Download directory: $ICLOUD_DIR"
    if [ -d "$ICLOUD_DIR" ]; then
        echo "  Size: $(du -sh "$ICLOUD_DIR" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1)"
        echo "  Files: $(find "$ICLOUD_DIR" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
    else
        echo "  Directory does not exist"
    fi
    echo ""

    echo "Last successful sync:"
    if [ -f "$SUCCESS_FILE" ]; then
        echo "  $(cat "$SUCCESS_FILE")"
    else
        echo "  Never (or no record)"
    fi
    echo ""

    echo "ntfy notifications:"
    echo "  Server: $NTFY_SERVER"
    echo "  Topic: $NTFY_TOPIC"
    echo ""

    echo "Recent log entries:"
    if [ -f "$LOG_FILE" ]; then
        tail -10 "$LOG_FILE"
    else
        echo "  No logs yet"
    fi
}

full_sync() {
    log "=== Full iCloud Sync ==="

    download_photos || {
        log "Download failed, skipping import"
        return 1
    }

    import_to_immich

    log "=== Sync complete ==="
}

case "$ACTION" in
    download)
        download_photos
        ;;
    import)
        import_to_immich
        ;;
    sync)
        full_sync
        ;;
    auth)
        authenticate
        ;;
    status)
        show_status
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: $0 [download|import|sync|auth|status]"
        echo ""
        echo "Commands:"
        echo "  auth      - Authenticate with iCloud (requires 2FA)"
        echo "  download  - Download photos from iCloud"
        echo "  import    - Import downloaded photos to Immich"
        echo "  sync      - Download + Import (full sync)"
        echo "  status    - Show sync status"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

The error is `Invalid email/password combination`. This means the app-specific password you entered was rejected by Apple. This could be because:

1. **Wrong password format** - App-specific passwords are 16 characters like `abcd-efgh-ijkl-mnop` (with or without dashes)
2. **Password was revoked** - The app-specific password may have been revoked in your Apple ID settings
3. **Typo** - Easy to mistype the long password

You need to:

1. Go to [appleid.apple.com/account/manage](https://appleid.apple.com/account/manage)
2. Sign in → Security → App-Specific Passwords
3. Generate a **new** app-specific password for "icloudpd" 
4. Copy it exactly (it's shown only once)
5. Run `task importer:icloud:auth` again and paste the new password

When entering the password, make sure you're pasting the app-specific password (the `xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx` format), not your regular Apple ID password.

I see the issue - the authentication actually **failed** with "Invalid email/password combination" but the script still printed "Authentication complete" because it doesn't check the exit code properly.

The error `code: "-20283"` means Apple rejected the password. 

**Important**: For icloudpd, you need to use your **regular iCloud password**, NOT an app-specific password. icloudpd uses Apple's web authentication flow which requires the actual account password + 2FA.

App-specific passwords are only for apps that don't support 2FA (like older email clients). icloudpd handles 2FA natively.

Try again with your **regular Apple ID password**:


how does icloudpd keep the icloud folders intact?

Looking at the icloudpd command in the script, it downloads to a flat directory (`--directory "$ICLOUD_DIR"`). By default, icloudpd organizes photos by date into subfolders like:

```
/downloads/icloud/
├── 2024/
│   ├── 01/
│   │   ├── photo1.jpg
│   │   └── photo2.heic
│   ├── 02/
│   ...
```

However, it does **not** preserve iCloud album structure. iCloud albums are virtual groupings, not actual folders - they're metadata stored in Apple's cloud. icloudpd can only download the actual files, not recreate albums.

If you want to preserve some organization, icloudpd has options:

```bash
# Organize by date (default)
--folder-structure {Y}/{m}/{d}    # 2024/12/12/
--folder-structure {Y}/{m}        # 2024/12/ (current default)

# Or keep it flat
--folder-structure none
```

For album preservation, you have a few options:

1. **Use immich-go's album creation** (current approach) - creates albums based on folder structure:
   ```bash
   immich-go upload -create-albums -album-name-template "iCloud/{year}/{month}"
   ```

2. **Download by album** - icloudpd can filter by album but still downloads flat:
   ```bash
   icloudpd --album "My Album Name" ...
   ```

3. **Use iCloud's Shared Albums** - These are separate and can be downloaded with `--list-albums` to see what's available

Would you like me to modify the script to use a different folder structure, or add album-based organization?

#!/bin/bash
# iCloud Photo Downloader + Immich Import
# Downloads photos from iCloud using icloudpd, then imports to Immich
#
# Usage:
#   icloud-sync.sh download     - Download new photos from iCloud
#   icloud-sync.sh import       - Import downloaded photos to Immich
#   icloud-sync.sh sync         - Download + Import (full sync)
#   icloud-sync.sh auth         - Authenticate with iCloud (2FA required)
#   icloud-sync.sh status       - Show sync status

set -eu

# Add uv tools to PATH (icloudpd installed via uv tool)
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"

ACTION="${1:-sync}"
ICLOUD_DIR="${ICLOUD_DOWNLOAD_DIR:-/downloads/icloud}"
COOKIE_DIR="/root/.icloudpd"
LOG_FILE="/var/log/icloud-sync.log"
SUCCESS_FILE="/var/log/icloud-last-success"

# Immich settings
IMMICH_SERVER="${IMMICH_SERVER:-http://192.168.1.222:2283}"
IMMICH_API_KEY="${IMMICH_API_KEY:-}"

# ntfy settings
NTFY_SERVER="${NTFY_SERVER:-https://ntfy.homelab.rambtech.dev}"
NTFY_TOPIC="${NTFY_TOPIC:-icloud-sync}"

log() {
    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $*" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
}

# Send notification via ntfy
notify() {
    local title="$1"
    local message="$2"
    local priority="${3:-default}"
    local tags="${4:-cloud}"

    curl -s -o /dev/null \
        -H "Title: $title" \
        -H "Priority: $priority" \
        -H "Tags: $tags" \
        -d "$message" \
        "$NTFY_SERVER/$NTFY_TOPIC" || true
}

notify_error() {
    local message="$1"
    log "ERROR: $message"
    notify "iCloud Sync Failed" "$message" "high" "warning,icloud"
}

notify_success() {
    local message="$1"
    log "SUCCESS: $message"
    # Only notify success on first sync after a failure, or weekly
    # to avoid notification spam
}

check_auth() {
    if [ ! -d "$COOKIE_DIR" ] || [ -z "$(find "$COOKIE_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
        notify_error "Not authenticated with iCloud. Run: icloud-sync.sh auth"
        log "Run: icloud-sync.sh auth"
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

authenticate() {
    log "=== iCloud Authentication ==="
    log "This will prompt for 2FA code"
    echo ""

    mkdir -p "$COOKIE_DIR"

    # Interactive authentication
    icloudpd --username "$ICLOUD_USERNAME" \
        --directory "$ICLOUD_DIR" \
        --cookie-directory "$COOKIE_DIR" \
        --auth-only

    log "Authentication complete. Cookies saved to $COOKIE_DIR"
}

download_photos() {
    log "=== Downloading photos from iCloud ==="

    if ! check_auth; then
        return 1
    fi

    mkdir -p "$ICLOUD_DIR"

    log "Download directory: $ICLOUD_DIR"
    log "Starting icloudpd download..."

    # Download with sensible defaults:
    # - Skip videos (optional, remove --skip-videos to include)
    # - Keep original file dates
    # - Download live photos as both photo and video
    # - Use recent photos first (most likely to be new)
    # - Auto-delete from iCloud after download (disabled by default)
    icloudpd --username "$ICLOUD_USERNAME" \
        --directory "$ICLOUD_DIR" \
        --cookie-directory "$COOKIE_DIR" \
        --size original \
        --live-photo-size original \
        --align-raw original \
        --set-exif-datetime \
        --no-progress-bar \
        --recent 500 \
        2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"

    local exit_code=${PIPESTATUS[0]}

    if [ "$exit_code" -eq 0 ]; then
        log "Download complete"
        date > "$SUCCESS_FILE"
    elif [ "$exit_code" -eq 1 ]; then
        notify_error "iCloud 2FA expired or auth error. SSH to immich-importer and run: icloud-sync.sh auth"
    else
        notify_error "iCloud download failed with exit code $exit_code. Check logs: /var/log/icloud-sync.log"
    fi

    return "$exit_code"
}

import_to_immich() {
    log "=== Importing to Immich ==="

    if [ -z "$IMMICH_API_KEY" ]; then
        log "ERROR: IMMICH_API_KEY not set"
        return 1
    fi

    if [ ! -d "$ICLOUD_DIR" ] || [ -z "$(find "$ICLOUD_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
        log "No photos to import in $ICLOUD_DIR"
        return 0
    fi

    log "Importing from: $ICLOUD_DIR"
    log "Immich server: $IMMICH_SERVER"

    # Use immich-go to upload
    # --skip-hash to speed up (Immich will dedupe anyway)
    immich-go -server "$IMMICH_SERVER" \
        -key "$IMMICH_API_KEY" \
        upload "$ICLOUD_DIR" \
        -create-albums \
        -album-name-template "iCloud/{year}/{month}" \
        2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"

    log "Import complete"
}

show_status() {
    echo "=== iCloud Sync Status ==="
    echo ""

    echo "Authentication:"
    if check_auth 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "  Status: Authenticated"
        echo "  Cookies: $COOKIE_DIR"
        ls -la "$COOKIE_DIR" 2>/dev/null | head -5
    else
        echo "  Status: NOT authenticated"
        echo "  Run: icloud-sync.sh auth"
    fi
    echo ""

    echo "Download directory: $ICLOUD_DIR"
    if [ -d "$ICLOUD_DIR" ]; then
        echo "  Size: $(du -sh "$ICLOUD_DIR" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1)"
        echo "  Files: $(find "$ICLOUD_DIR" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
    else
        echo "  Directory does not exist"
    fi
    echo ""

    echo "Last successful sync:"
    if [ -f "$SUCCESS_FILE" ]; then
        echo "  $(cat "$SUCCESS_FILE")"
    else
        echo "  Never (or no record)"
    fi
    echo ""

    echo "ntfy notifications:"
    echo "  Server: $NTFY_SERVER"
    echo "  Topic: $NTFY_TOPIC"
    echo ""

    echo "Recent log entries:"
    if [ -f "$LOG_FILE" ]; then
        tail -10 "$LOG_FILE"
    else
        echo "  No logs yet"
    fi
}

full_sync() {
    log "=== Full iCloud Sync ==="

    download_photos || {
        log "Download failed, skipping import"
        return 1
    }

    import_to_immich

    log "=== Sync complete ==="
}

case "$ACTION" in
    download)
        download_photos
        ;;
    import)
        import_to_immich
        ;;
    sync)
        full_sync
        ;;
    auth)
        authenticate
        ;;
    status)
        show_status
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: $0 [download|import|sync|auth|status]"
        echo ""
        echo "Commands:"
        echo "  auth      - Authenticate with iCloud (requires 2FA)"
        echo "  download  - Download photos from iCloud"
        echo "  import    - Import downloaded photos to Immich"
        echo "  sync      - Download + Import (full sync)"
        echo "  status    - Show sync status"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

#!/bin/bash
# iCloud Photo Downloader + Immich Import
# Downloads photos from iCloud using icloudpd, then imports to Immich
#
# Usage:
#   icloud-sync.sh download        - Download recent photos (date-based folders)
#   icloud-sync.sh albums          - Download all albums (preserves album structure)
#   icloud-sync.sh albums "Name"   - Download specific album
#   icloud-sync.sh list-albums     - List available iCloud albums
#   icloud-sync.sh import          - Import downloaded photos to Immich
#   icloud-sync.sh sync            - Download recent + Import (quick sync)
#   icloud-sync.sh sync-albums     - Download all albums + Import (full sync)
#   icloud-sync.sh auth            - Authenticate with iCloud (2FA required)
#   icloud-sync.sh status          - Show sync status

set -eu

# Add uv tools to PATH (icloudpd installed via uv tool)
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"

ACTION="${1:-sync}"
ICLOUD_DIR="${ICLOUD_DOWNLOAD_DIR:-/downloads/icloud}"
COOKIE_DIR="/root/.icloudpd"
LOG_FILE="/var/log/icloud-sync.log"
SUCCESS_FILE="/var/log/icloud-last-success"

# Immich settings
IMMICH_SERVER="${IMMICH_SERVER:-http://192.168.1.222:2283}"
IMMICH_API_KEY="${IMMICH_API_KEY:-}"

# ntfy settings
NTFY_SERVER="${NTFY_SERVER:-https://ntfy.homelab.rambtech.dev}"
NTFY_TOPIC="${NTFY_TOPIC:-icloud-sync}"

log() {
    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $*" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
}

# Send notification via ntfy
notify() {
    local title="$1"
    local message="$2"
    local priority="${3:-default}"
    local tags="${4:-cloud}"

    curl -s -o /dev/null \
        -H "Title: $title" \
        -H "Priority: $priority" \
        -H "Tags: $tags" \
        -d "$message" \
        "$NTFY_SERVER/$NTFY_TOPIC" || true
}

notify_error() {
    local message="$1"
    log "ERROR: $message"
    notify "iCloud Sync Failed" "$message" "high" "warning,icloud"
}

notify_success() {
    local message="$1"
    log "SUCCESS: $message"
    # Only notify success on first sync after a failure, or weekly
    # to avoid notification spam
}

check_auth() {
    if [ ! -d "$COOKIE_DIR" ] || [ -z "$(find "$COOKIE_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
        notify_error "Not authenticated with iCloud. Run: icloud-sync.sh auth"
        log "Run: icloud-sync.sh auth"
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

authenticate() {
    log "=== iCloud Authentication ==="
    log "This will prompt for 2FA code"
    echo ""

    mkdir -p "$COOKIE_DIR"

    # Interactive authentication
    icloudpd --username "$ICLOUD_USERNAME" \
        --directory "$ICLOUD_DIR" \
        --cookie-directory "$COOKIE_DIR" \
        --auth-only

    log "Authentication complete. Cookies saved to $COOKIE_DIR"
}

download_photos() {
    log "=== Downloading photos from iCloud ==="

    if ! check_auth; then
        return 1
    fi

    mkdir -p "$ICLOUD_DIR"

    log "Download directory: $ICLOUD_DIR"
    log "Starting icloudpd download..."

    # Download with sensible defaults:
    # - Skip videos (optional, remove --skip-videos to include)
    # - Keep original file dates
    # - Download live photos as both photo and video
    # - Use recent photos first (most likely to be new)
    # - Auto-delete from iCloud after download (disabled by default)
    icloudpd --username "$ICLOUD_USERNAME" \
        --directory "$ICLOUD_DIR" \
        --cookie-directory "$COOKIE_DIR" \
        --size original \
        --live-photo-size original \
        --align-raw original \
        --set-exif-datetime \
        --no-progress-bar \
        --recent 500 \
        2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"

    local exit_code=${PIPESTATUS[0]}

    if [ "$exit_code" -eq 0 ]; then
        log "Download complete"
        date > "$SUCCESS_FILE"
    elif [ "$exit_code" -eq 1 ]; then
        notify_error "iCloud 2FA expired or auth error. SSH to immich-importer and run: icloud-sync.sh auth"
    else
        notify_error "iCloud download failed with exit code $exit_code. Check logs: /var/log/icloud-sync.log"
    fi

    return "$exit_code"
}

import_to_immich() {
    log "=== Importing to Immich ==="

    if [ -z "$IMMICH_API_KEY" ]; then
        log "ERROR: IMMICH_API_KEY not set"
        return 1
    fi

    if [ ! -d "$ICLOUD_DIR" ] || [ -z "$(find "$ICLOUD_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
        log "No photos to import in $ICLOUD_DIR"
        return 0
    fi

    log "Importing from: $ICLOUD_DIR"
    log "Immich server: $IMMICH_SERVER"

    # Use immich-go to upload
    # --skip-hash to speed up (Immich will dedupe anyway)
    immich-go -server "$IMMICH_SERVER" \
        -key "$IMMICH_API_KEY" \
        upload "$ICLOUD_DIR" \
        -create-albums \
        -album-name-template "iCloud/{year}/{month}" \
        2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"

    log "Import complete"
}

show_status() {
    echo "=== iCloud Sync Status ==="
    echo ""

    echo "Authentication:"
    if check_auth 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "  Status: Authenticated"
        echo "  Cookies: $COOKIE_DIR"
        ls -la "$COOKIE_DIR" 2>/dev/null | head -5
    else
        echo "  Status: NOT authenticated"
        echo "  Run: icloud-sync.sh auth"
    fi
    echo ""

    echo "Download directory: $ICLOUD_DIR"
    if [ -d "$ICLOUD_DIR" ]; then
        echo "  Size: $(du -sh "$ICLOUD_DIR" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1)"
        echo "  Files: $(find "$ICLOUD_DIR" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
    else
        echo "  Directory does not exist"
    fi
    echo ""

    echo "Last successful sync:"
    if [ -f "$SUCCESS_FILE" ]; then
        echo "  $(cat "$SUCCESS_FILE")"
    else
        echo "  Never (or no record)"
    fi
    echo ""

    echo "ntfy notifications:"
    echo "  Server: $NTFY_SERVER"
    echo "  Topic: $NTFY_TOPIC"
    echo ""

    echo "Recent log entries:"
    if [ -f "$LOG_FILE" ]; then
        tail -10 "$LOG_FILE"
    else
        echo "  No logs yet"
    fi
}

full_sync() {
    log "=== Full iCloud Sync ==="

    download_photos || {
        log "Download failed, skipping import"
        return 1
    }

    import_to_immich

    log "=== Sync complete ==="
}

case "$ACTION" in
    download)
        download_photos
        ;;
    import)
        import_to_immich
        ;;
    sync)
        full_sync
        ;;
    auth)
        authenticate
        ;;
    status)
        show_status
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: $0 [download|import|sync|auth|status]"
        echo ""
        echo "Commands:"
        echo "  auth      - Authenticate with iCloud (requires 2FA)"
        echo "  download  - Download photos from iCloud"
        echo "  import    - Import downloaded photos to Immich"
        echo "  sync      - Download + Import (full sync)"
        echo "  status    - Show sync status"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

# Add uv tools to PATH (icloudpd installed via uv tool)
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"

ALBUM_ARG="${2:-}"

        -H "Title: $title" \
        -H "Priority: $priority" \
        -H "Tags: $tags" \
        -d "$message" \
        "$NTFY_SERVER/$NTFY_TOPIC" || true
}

notify_error() {
    local message="$1"
    log "ERROR: $message"
    notify "iCloud Sync Failed" "$message" "high" "warning,icloud"
}

notify_success() {
    local message="$1"
    log "SUCCESS: $message"
    # Only notify success on first sync after a failure, or weekly
    # to avoid notification spam
}

check_auth() {
    if [ ! -d "$COOKIE_DIR" ] || [ -z "$(find "$COOKIE_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
        notify_error "Not authenticated with iCloud. Run: icloud-sync.sh auth"
        log "Run: icloud-sync.sh auth"

    fi
    return 0

    log "=== iCloud Authentication ==="
    log "This will prompt for 2FA code"
    echo ""

    mkdir -p "$COOKIE_DIR"

    # Interactive authentication
    icloudpd --username "$ICLOUD_USERNAME" \
        --directory "$ICLOUD_DIR" \
        --cookie-directory "$COOKIE_DIR" \
        --auth-only

    log "Authentication complete. Cookies saved to $COOKIE_DIR"
}

download_photos() {
    log "=== Downloading photos from iCloud ==="

    if ! check_auth; then
        return 1
    fi

    mkdir -p "$ICLOUD_DIR"

    log "Download directory: $ICLOUD_DIR"
    log "Starting icloudpd download..."

    # Download with sensible defaults:
    # - Skip videos (optional, remove --skip-videos to include)
    # - Keep original file dates
    # - Download live photos as both photo and video
    # - Use recent photos first (most likely to be new)
    # - Auto-delete from iCloud after download (disabled by default)
    icloudpd --username "$ICLOUD_USERNAME" \
        --directory "$ICLOUD_DIR" \
        --cookie-directory "$COOKIE_DIR" \
        --size original \

        --align-raw original \
        --set-exif-datetime \
        --no-progress-bar \

        notify_error "iCloud download failed with exit code $exit_code. Check logs: /var/log/icloud-sync.log"
    fi

    return "$exit_code"

        log "ERROR: IMMICH_API_KEY not set"

        -key "$IMMICH_API_KEY" \
        upload "$ICLOUD_DIR" \
        -create-albums \
        -album-name-template "iCloud/{year}/{month}" \
        2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"

    log "Import complete"
}

show_status() {
    echo "=== iCloud Sync Status ==="
    echo ""

    echo "Authentication:"
    if check_auth 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "  Status: Authenticated"
        echo "  Cookies: $COOKIE_DIR"
        ls -la "$COOKIE_DIR" 2>/dev/null | head -5
    else
        echo "  Status: NOT authenticated"
        echo "  Run: icloud-sync.sh auth"
    fi
    echo ""

    echo "Download directory: $ICLOUD_DIR"
    if [ -d "$ICLOUD_DIR" ]; then
        echo "  Size: $(du -sh "$ICLOUD_DIR" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1)"
        echo "  Files: $(find "$ICLOUD_DIR" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
    else
        echo "  Directory does not exist"
    fi
    echo ""

    echo "Last successful sync:"
    if [ -f "$SUCCESS_FILE" ]; then
        echo "  $(cat "$SUCCESS_FILE")"
    else
        echo "  Never (or no record)"
    fi
    echo ""

    echo "ntfy notifications:"
    echo "  Server: $NTFY_SERVER"
    echo "  Topic: $NTFY_TOPIC"
    echo ""

    echo "Recent log entries:"
    if [ -f "$LOG_FILE" ]; then
        tail -10 "$LOG_FILE"
    else
        echo "  No logs yet"
    fi
}

full_sync() {
    log "=== Full iCloud Sync ==="

    download_photos || {
        log "Download failed, skipping import"
        return 1
    }

    import_to_immich

    log "=== Sync complete ==="
}

case "$ACTION" in

esac

#!/bin/bash
# iCloud Photo Downloader + Immich Import
# Downloads photos from iCloud using icloudpd, then imports to Immich
#
# Usage:
#   icloud-sync.sh download        - Download recent photos (date-based folders)
#   icloud-sync.sh albums          - Download all albums (preserves album structure)
#   icloud-sync.sh albums "Name"   - Download specific album
#   icloud-sync.sh list-albums     - List available iCloud albums
#   icloud-sync.sh import          - Import downloaded photos to Immich
#   icloud-sync.sh sync            - Download recent + Import (quick sync)
#   icloud-sync.sh sync-albums     - Download all albums + Import (full sync)
#   icloud-sync.sh auth            - Authenticate with iCloud (2FA required)
#   icloud-sync.sh status          - Show sync status

set -eu

# Add uv tools to PATH (icloudpd installed via uv tool)
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"

ACTION="${1:-sync}"
ALBUM_ARG="${2:-}"
ICLOUD_DIR="${ICLOUD_DOWNLOAD_DIR:-/downloads/icloud}"
ALBUMS_DIR="${ICLOUD_DIR}/albums"
COOKIE_DIR="/root/.icloudpd"
LOG_FILE="/var/log/icloud-sync.log"
SUCCESS_FILE="/var/log/icloud-last-success"

# Immich settings
IMMICH_SERVER="${IMMICH_SERVER:-http://192.168.1.222:2283}"
IMMICH_API_KEY="${IMMICH_API_KEY:-}"

# ntfy settings
NTFY_SERVER="${NTFY_SERVER:-https://ntfy.homelab.rambtech.dev}"
NTFY_TOPIC="${NTFY_TOPIC:-icloud-sync}"

log() {
    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $*" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
}

# Send notification via ntfy
notify() {
    local title="$1"
    local message="$2"
    local priority="${3:-default}"
    local tags="${4:-cloud}"

    curl -s -o /dev/null \
        -H "Title: $title" \
        -H "Priority: $priority" \
        -H "Tags: $tags" \
        -d "$message" \
        "$NTFY_SERVER/$NTFY_TOPIC" || true
}

notify_error() {
    local message="$1"
    log "ERROR: $message"
    notify "iCloud Sync Failed" "$message" "high" "warning,icloud"
}

notify_success() {
    local message="$1"
    log "SUCCESS: $message"
    # Only notify success on first sync after a failure, or weekly
    # to avoid notification spam
}

check_auth() {
    if [ ! -d "$COOKIE_DIR" ] || [ -z "$(find "$COOKIE_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
        notify_error "Not authenticated with iCloud. Run: icloud-sync.sh auth"
        log "Run: icloud-sync.sh auth"
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

authenticate() {
    log "=== iCloud Authentication ==="
    log "This will prompt for 2FA code"
    echo ""

    mkdir -p "$COOKIE_DIR"

    # Interactive authentication
    icloudpd --username "$ICLOUD_USERNAME" \
        --directory "$ICLOUD_DIR" \
        --cookie-directory "$COOKIE_DIR" \
        --auth-only

    log "Authentication complete. Cookies saved to $COOKIE_DIR"
}

download_photos() {
    log "=== Downloading photos from iCloud ==="

    if ! check_auth; then
        return 1
    fi

    mkdir -p "$ICLOUD_DIR"

    log "Download directory: $ICLOUD_DIR"
    log "Starting icloudpd download..."

    # Download with sensible defaults:
    # - Keep original file dates
    # - Download live photos as both photo and video
    # - Use recent photos first (most likely to be new)
    icloudpd --username "$ICLOUD_USERNAME" \
        --directory "$ICLOUD_DIR" \
        --cookie-directory "$COOKIE_DIR" \
        --size original \
        --live-photo-size original \
        --align-raw original \
        --set-exif-datetime \
        --no-progress-bar \
        --recent 500 \
        2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"

    local exit_code=${PIPESTATUS[0]}

    if [ "$exit_code" -eq 0 ]; then
        log "Download complete"
        date > "$SUCCESS_FILE"
    elif [ "$exit_code" -eq 1 ]; then
        notify_error "iCloud 2FA expired or auth error. SSH to immich-importer and run: icloud-sync.sh auth"
    else
        notify_error "iCloud download failed with exit code $exit_code. Check logs: /var/log/icloud-sync.log"
    fi

    return "$exit_code"
}

list_albums() {
    log "=== Listing iCloud Albums ==="

    if ! check_auth; then
        return 1
    fi

    icloudpd --username "$ICLOUD_USERNAME" \
        --cookie-directory "$COOKIE_DIR" \
        --list-albums \
        2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
}

download_album() {
    local album_name="$1"
    local album_dir="$ALBUMS_DIR/$album_name"

    log "Downloading album: $album_name"
    mkdir -p "$album_dir"

    icloudpd --username "$ICLOUD_USERNAME" \
        --directory "$album_dir" \
        --cookie-directory "$COOKIE_DIR" \
        --album "$album_name" \
        --size original \
        --live-photo-size original \
        --align-raw original \
        --set-exif-datetime \
        --no-progress-bar \
        --folder-structure none \
        2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"

    return "${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
}

download_all_albums() {
    log "=== Downloading all iCloud Albums ==="

    if ! check_auth; then
        return 1
    fi

    mkdir -p "$ALBUMS_DIR"

    # Get list of albums (skip header lines and special albums)
    local albums
    albums=$(icloudpd --username "$ICLOUD_USERNAME" \
        --cookie-directory "$COOKIE_DIR" \
        --list-albums 2>/dev/null | \
        grep -v "^Albums:" | \
        grep -v "^Processing" | \
        grep -v "^$" | \
        grep -v "Recently Deleted" | \
        grep -v "Hidden")

    local total=0
    local success=0
    local failed=0

    while IFS= read -r album; do
        [ -z "$album" ] && continue
        total=$((total + 1))
        log "[$total] Downloading album: $album"

        if download_album "$album"; then
            success=$((success + 1))
        else
            failed=$((failed + 1))
            log "WARNING: Failed to download album: $album"
        fi
    done <<< "$albums"

    log "Album download complete: $success succeeded, $failed failed out of $total"

    if [ "$failed" -eq 0 ]; then
        date > "$SUCCESS_FILE"
        return 0
    else
        return 1
    fi
}

import_to_immich() {
    log "=== Importing to Immich ==="

    if [ -z "$IMMICH_API_KEY" ]; then
        log "ERROR: IMMICH_API_KEY not set"
        return 1
    fi

    if [ ! -d "$ICLOUD_DIR" ] || [ -z "$(find "$ICLOUD_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
        log "No photos to import in $ICLOUD_DIR"
        return 0
    fi

    log "Importing from: $ICLOUD_DIR"
    log "Immich server: $IMMICH_SERVER"

    # Use immich-go to upload
    # --skip-hash to speed up (Immich will dedupe anyway)
    immich-go -server "$IMMICH_SERVER" \
        -key "$IMMICH_API_KEY" \
        upload "$ICLOUD_DIR" \
        -create-albums \
        -album-name-template "iCloud/{year}/{month}" \
        2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"

    log "Import complete"
}

show_status() {
    echo "=== iCloud Sync Status ==="
    echo ""

    echo "Authentication:"
    if check_auth 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "  Status: Authenticated"
        echo "  Cookies: $COOKIE_DIR"
        ls -la "$COOKIE_DIR" 2>/dev/null | head -5
    else
        echo "  Status: NOT authenticated"
        echo "  Run: icloud-sync.sh auth"
    fi
    echo ""

    echo "Download directory: $ICLOUD_DIR"
    if [ -d "$ICLOUD_DIR" ]; then
        echo "  Size: $(du -sh "$ICLOUD_DIR" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1)"
        echo "  Files: $(find "$ICLOUD_DIR" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
    else
        echo "  Directory does not exist"
    fi
    echo ""

    echo "Last successful sync:"
    if [ -f "$SUCCESS_FILE" ]; then
        echo "  $(cat "$SUCCESS_FILE")"
    else
        echo "  Never (or no record)"
    fi
    echo ""

    echo "ntfy notifications:"
    echo "  Server: $NTFY_SERVER"
    echo "  Topic: $NTFY_TOPIC"
    echo ""

    echo "Recent log entries:"
    if [ -f "$LOG_FILE" ]; then
        tail -10 "$LOG_FILE"
    else
        echo "  No logs yet"
    fi
}

full_sync() {
    log "=== Full iCloud Sync ==="

    download_photos || {
        log "Download failed, skipping import"
        return 1
    }

    import_to_immich

    log "=== Sync complete ==="
}

case "$ACTION" in
    download)
        download_photos
        ;;
    import)
        import_to_immich
        ;;
    sync)
        full_sync
        ;;
    auth)
        authenticate
        ;;
    status)
        show_status
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: $0 [download|import|sync|auth|status]"
        echo ""
        echo "Commands:"
        echo "  auth      - Authenticate with iCloud (requires 2FA)"
        echo "  download  - Download photos from iCloud"
        echo "  import    - Import downloaded photos to Immich"
        echo "  sync      - Download + Import (full sync)"
        echo "  status    - Show sync status"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

            upload "$ICLOUD_DIR" \
            -create-albums \
            -album-name-template "iCloud/{year}/{month}" \
            2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
    fi

    # Import album-based photos (from albums command)
    if [ -d "$ALBUMS_DIR" ]; then
        for album_path in "$ALBUMS_DIR"/*/; do
            [ -d "$album_path" ] || continue
            album_name=$(basename "$album_path")

            if [ -n "$(find "$album_path" -type f 2>/dev/null | head -1)" ]; then
                log "Importing album: $album_name"
                immich-go -server "$IMMICH_SERVER" \
                    -key "$IMMICH_API_KEY" \
                    upload "$album_path" \
                    -create-albums \
                    -album-name-template "iCloud Albums/$album_name" \
                    2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
            fi
        done
    fi

    log "Import complete"
}

show_status() {
    echo "=== iCloud Sync Status ==="
    echo ""

    echo "Authentication:"
    if check_auth 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "  Status: Authenticated"
        echo "  Cookies: $COOKIE_DIR"
        ls -la "$COOKIE_DIR" 2>/dev/null | head -5
    else
        echo "  Status: NOT authenticated"
        echo "  Run: icloud-sync.sh auth"
    fi
    echo ""

    echo "Download directory: $ICLOUD_DIR"
    if [ -d "$ICLOUD_DIR" ]; then
        echo "  Size: $(du -sh "$ICLOUD_DIR" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1)"
        echo "  Files: $(find "$ICLOUD_DIR" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l)"
    else
        echo "  Directory does not exist"
    fi
    echo ""

    echo "Last successful sync:"
    if [ -f "$SUCCESS_FILE" ]; then
        echo "  $(cat "$SUCCESS_FILE")"
    else
        echo "  Never (or no record)"
    fi
    echo ""

    echo "ntfy notifications:"
    echo "  Server: $NTFY_SERVER"
    echo "  Topic: $NTFY_TOPIC"
    echo ""

    echo "Recent log entries:"
    if [ -f "$LOG_FILE" ]; then
        tail -10 "$LOG_FILE"
    else
        echo "  No logs yet"
    fi
}

full_sync() {
    log "=== Full iCloud Sync ==="

    download_photos || {
        log "Download failed, skipping import"
        return 1
    }

    import_to_immich

    log "=== Sync complete ==="
}

case "$ACTION" in
    download)
        download_photos
        ;;
    import)
        import_to_immich
        ;;
    sync)
        full_sync
        ;;
    auth)
        authenticate
        ;;
    status)
        show_status
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: $0 [download|import|sync|auth|status]"
        echo ""
        echo "Commands:"
        echo "  auth      - Authenticate with iCloud (requires 2FA)"
        echo "  download  - Download photos from iCloud"
        echo "  import    - Import downloaded photos to Immich"
        echo "  sync      - Download + Import (full sync)"
        echo "  status    - Show sync status"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

    desc: "Initialize OpenTofu for an app (APP=dashboards|openwebui|portainer)"

    cmds:

# OpenTofu IaC Commands
# https://taskfile.dev
#
# Each app has its own state file in tofu/apps/<app>/
# Use APP=dashboards|openwebui|portainer|etc to specify which app

version: '3'

vars:
  TOFU_DIR: "tofu"

tasks:
  tofu:init:
    desc: "Initialize OpenTofu for an app (APP=dashboards|openwebui|portainer)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu init
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:plan:
    desc: "Plan infrastructure changes for an app (optional: REPLACE='resource.name')"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - pwd
      - tofu plan -out=tfplan {{if .REPLACE}}-replace='{{.REPLACE}}'{{end}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -d .terraform
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:init APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:apply:
    desc: "Apply planned infrastructure changes for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu apply tfplan
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -f tfplan
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:plan APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:destroy:
    desc: "Destroy an app's infrastructure"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - echo "⚠️  This will destroy {{.APP}} infrastructure!"
      - tofu destroy
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    prompt: "Are you sure you want to destroy {{.APP}}?"

  tofu:output:
    desc: "Show infrastructure outputs for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu output
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:state:
    desc: "List all resources in an app's state"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu state list
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:state:rm:
    desc: "Remove a resource from state (APP, RESOURCE)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu state rm '{{.RESOURCE}}'
    requires:
      vars: [APP, RESOURCE]

  tofu:import:
    desc: "Import existing resource into state (APP, ADDR, ID)"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu import '{{.ADDR}}' '{{.ID}}'
    requires:
      vars: [APP, ADDR, ID]

  tofu:show:
    desc: "Show saved plan details for an app"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu show tfplan
    requires:
      vars: [APP]
    preconditions:
      - sh: test -f tfplan
        msg: "Run 'task tofu:plan APP={{.APP}}' first"

  tofu:fmt:
    desc: "Format all Terraform files"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu fmt -recursive

  tofu:validate:
    desc: "Validate an app's configuration"
    dir: "{{.TOFU_DIR}}/apps/{{.APP}}"
    cmds:
      - tofu validate
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:encryption:setup:
    desc: "Set up state encryption passphrase in 1Password"
    cmds:
      - |
        echo "Creating 1Password item for state encryption..."
        PASSPHRASE=$(openssl rand -base64 32)
        op item create \
          --category=password \
          --title="opentofu" \
          --vault="homelab" \
          "password=$PASSPHRASE" \
          "notes=OpenTofu state encryption passphrase for homelab IaC"
        echo "✅ Created 1Password item 'opentofu'"
        echo "The passphrase will be automatically retrieved when running tofu commands"

  tofu:encryption:test:
    desc: "Test state encryption passphrase retrieval"
    cmds:
      - |
        if [ -n "$TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase" ]; then
          echo "✅ State encryption passphrase is set (${#TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase} chars)"
        else
          echo "❌ State encryption passphrase not set"
          echo "Run 'task tofu:encryption:setup' or set TF_VAR_state_encryption_passphrase"
          exit 1
        fi

  tofu:ssh:
    desc: "SSH to a deployed LXC by app name"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/ssh.sh {{.APP}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP]

  tofu:logs:
    desc: "View Docker logs from a deployed app"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/logs.sh {{.APP}} {{.SERVICE}}
    requires:
      vars: [APP, SERVICE]

  tofu:info:
    desc: "Show OpenTofu IaC status"
    cmds:
      - ./scripts/tofu/info.sh
